summary: Applies unary or binary math functions to CHOP channels, including trigonometric, logarithmic, exponential, power, and dB/power/amplitude conversions.
key_concepts: Applies selected math functions to CHOP channel samples, with most functions using only the first input.
Binary functions such as atan2 and Input1 to the power of Input2 use the second input and the Match parameter to pair channels.
Base Value and Exponent Value feed the log and power modes that need constants instead of a second input.
Error Handling can abort cooking, replace bad samples with specified values, or reuse the previous good value.
Angle Units controls trigonometric interpretation as degrees, radians, or cycles.

key_params.name: match
key_params.note: Pair binary-function channels by index or name

key_params.name: error
key_params.note: Abort, replace with specified values, or use previous value on math errors

common_gotchas: Most functions use only input 1, but atan2 and input1^input2 style functions use a second input.
Input channels from two inputs are paired by name or index depending on common CHOP matching behavior.
Trigonometric, log, sqrt, and power functions can produce domain, infinity, or divide errors.
Abort mode is useful for debugging; replace or previous-value modes are safer for live systems.
dB/power/amplitude conversions are not interchangeable; choose based on whether values represent signal power or amplitude.
